gloss: hair at the back of the head; lingering attachment

definitions.gloss: hair at the back of the head
definitions.explanation: The hair growing at the back of one's head.
A feeling of being unable to leave something behind, as if someone were pulling you back by the hair. Used primarily in the idiom 後ろ髪を引かれる.

examples.japanese: {後|うし}ろ{髪|がみ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦まとめる→まとめる：02424_matomeru⟧。
examples.english: To tie up the hair at the back of one's head.

examples.japanese: {後|うし}ろ{髪|がみ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{首|くび}→首：00792_kubi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
examples.english: The hair at the back touches the neck.

examples.japanese: {後|うし}ろ{髪|がみ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{伸|の}びて→伸びる：01974_nobiru⟧きた⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{美容院|びよういん}→美容院：06319_biyouin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}かなければ→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: The hair at the back of my head has gotten long, so I need to go to the salon.

examples.japanese: {後|うし}ろ{髪|がみ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}かれる→引く：01978_hiku⟧⟦{思|おも}い→思い：10248_omoi⟧。
⟦{故郷|ふるさと}→故郷：25466_furusato⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{離|はな}れる→離れる：02397_hanareru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{後|うし}ろ{髪|がみ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}かれた→引く：01978_hiku⟧。
examples.english: Leaving my hometown was hard to do — I felt pulled back.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{預|あず}けて→預ける：01819_azukeru⟧⟦{出勤|しゅっきん}→出勤：04548_shukkin⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{毎朝|まいあさ}→毎朝：00966_maiasa⟧{後|うし}ろ{髪|がみ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}かれる→引く：01978_hiku⟧⟦{思|おも}い→思い：10248_omoi⟧だ。
examples.english: Leaving my child behind and going to work feels like a reluctant parting every morning.

notes:
The literal meaning (sense 1) refers to the hair at the back of the head, but the word is far more commonly encountered in the idiomatic expression {後|うし}ろ{髪|がみ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}かれる→引く：01978_hiku⟧ (sense 2).

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
The expression {後|うし}ろ{髪|がみ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}かれる→引く：01978_hiku⟧ literally means "to have one's hair pulled from behind" — evoking the image of being physically held back as you try to leave. It expresses deep reluctance to part with someone or something, a strong emotional pull to stay.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {後|うし}ろ{髪|がみ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}かれる→引く：01978_hiku⟧ — to feel reluctant to leave; to feel a lingering attachment
- {後|うし}ろ{髪|がみ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}かれる→引く：01978_hiku⟧⟦{思|おも}い→思い：10248_omoi⟧ — a feeling of lingering reluctance
- {後|うし}ろ{髪|がみ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}かれ→引く：01978_hiku⟧⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧ — while reluctantly leaving

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{未練|みれん}→未練：04866_miren⟧ — lingering attachment, regret; a broader term for reluctance to let go
- ⟦{名残惜|なごりお}しい→名残惜しい：10910_nagorioshii⟧ — sad to part; a direct expression of reluctance at parting
